create_laguna_config: create a LagunaConfig with custom num_attention_heads_per_layer and mlp_layer_types for a 40-layer MoE model
build_laguna_model: build a LagunaModel from a LagunaConfig to run forward passes on tokenized input sequences
run_laguna_for_causal_lm: run LagunaForCausalLM forward pass with input_ids and labels to compute causal language modeling loss
review_laguna_sparse_moe_block: review the LagunaSparseMoeBlock forward method to understand how shared and routed experts are combined with scaling
test_laguna_topk_router: test the LagunaTopKRouter forward method to verify sigmoid routing scores and top-k expert selection with softcapping
